# Drawing line caps

Original fixture generated by tools/line_cap_fixture.py from our original rotation fixture. The reference application exported this single-page PDF without saving the DOCX. No external artwork. JSON hashes bind the source and reference. Its paths, widths, PDF line-cap operators and dash arrays come directly from the PDF content stream. Pixel samples use a 4px/pt PDF raster, selecting only neighborhoods uniformly filled by the expected stroke color or uniformly white; boundary antialiasing and overlaps are excluded.

The 22 probes cover explicit flat/round/square and absent caps, solid/dot/system-dot/dash-dot lines, rotations/reflections and nested scales. A diagonal square cap extends beyond the drawing frame. The reference application treats an absent cap as flat, diverging from the square default stated in ECMA-376 Part 1 20.1.2.2.24. Round/square dash centerlines shorten each dash by one pen width and lengthen each gap by one pen width; zero-length dash entries produce dots.
